author: J. C. Kemp
title: Hayfield Secondary School's 7th graders lead in 2024-25 math MCA participation
text:
According to the Minnesota Department of Education , Hayfield Secondary School saw its seventh-grade students achieve the highest participation rate in the mathematics section of the 2024-25 MCA.
At Hayfield Secondary School, 57 of the 183 students who completed that part of the test were from the seventh grade.
Test results show that 35% of seventh-grade students met proficiency standards in mathematics.
The MCA and the Alternate Minnesota Comprehensive Assessment (Alt MCA) are statewide tests used to assess student progress on Minnesota’s academic standards and satisfy federal and state laws. Subjects include math, reading and science, depending on the student’s grade. Most students participate in the MCA, while eligible students receiving special education services may take the Alt MCA.
According to Minnesota’s Report Card, proficiency rates on Minnesota’s MCA exams remain below pre-pandemic figures . Math proficiency declined more than 7% since 2019, and reading proficiency is nearly 5% lower.
Mathematics MCA at Hayfield Secondary School (2024-25): Participation and Proficiency by Grade Grade # of Students Tested Proficiency in mathematics 6th 36 19% 7th 57 35% 8th 46 37% 11th 44 16% *Data for small student groups is suppressed by some schools to ensure privacy. The information in this article came from the Minnesota Department of Education. Source data is available here .
